copy: Mary Cassatt: After Impressionism. Through January 3 Discover the bold and innovative work of Mary Cassatt in this gathering of over 70 experimental and ambitious works made at the height of her career. Tickets to this show are $7 in addition to general admission. Members never need tickets and enjoy two days of member previews and a member-only viewing hour, 10–11 a.m., every day we’re open!
